title: Color Picker Component Test Cases — Runnable Companion
title_es: Casos de Prueba de Color Picker — Companion Ejecutable
description: Playwright 1.48 + axe-core 4.10 spec for color picker components (hex input, invalid input, clipboard, a11y scan) plus stdlib Node utilities for hex parsing/validation and the WCAG 2.x contrast ratio, with a node:test suite.
description_es: Spec de Playwright 1.48 + axe-core 4.10 para el componente color picker (input hex, input inválido, portapapeles, escaneo a11y) más utilidades Node stdlib para parseo/validación hex y el ratio de contraste WCAG 2.x, con suite node:test.
requirements: Node.js 20+; Playwright 1.48 for the e2e spec
